strings.zh: 你好,我家的尼多朗{NEWLINE}最近总是吃不下饭还呕吐,{CLEAR}我因为要照顾尼多朗无法走开,{CLEAR}能拜托你去找尼比馆主小刚来看一下吗？{CLEAR}小刚是有名的口袋妖怪饲育家,{CLEAR}我想他一定有办法的。
strings.en: Hello... My Nidoran♂ hasn’t been eating{NEWLINE}lately, and it keeps throwing up.{SCROLL}I can’t leave it alone, so could you{NEWLINE}please go get Brock, the Pewter Gym{CLEAR}Leader, to take a look?{SCROLL}Brock is a famous Pokémon Breeder. I’m{NEWLINE}sure he’ll know what to do.
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s), same position; qa-lints: Nidoran♀/♂ per zh 尼多兰/尼多朗 (glossary, RB-D01)

strings.zh: 尼多朗『……{SCROLL}尼多朗没有精神。
strings.en: Nidoran♂: ...{SCROLL}Nidoran♂ looks listless.
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s), same position, flags page_breaks_lost; qa-lints: Nidoran♀/♂ per zh 尼多兰/尼多朗 (glossary, RB-D01)

strings.zh: 小刚先生正在为尼多朗诊断,{NEWLINE}有他在这里我就放心了。
strings.en: Mr. Brock is examining Nidoran♂ right{NEWLINE}now. With him here, I can relax.
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s), same position; qa-lints: Nidoran♀/♂ per zh 尼多兰/尼多朗 (glossary, RB-D01)

strings.zh: 我的尼多朗已经恢复健康了！{CLEAR}有小刚先生坐镇我们尼比市{CLEAR}真是太好了。
strings.en: My Nidoran♂ is all better! It’s so good{NEWLINE}to have Mr. Brock looking out for{CLEAR}Pewter City.
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s), same position; qa-lints: Nidoran♀/♂ per zh 尼多兰/尼多朗 (glossary, RB-D01)

strings.zh: 尼多朗『Ga——！Ni！{SCROLL}尼多朗很有精神！
strings.en: Nidoran♂: Ga-! Ni!{SCROLL}Nidoran♂ is full of energy!
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s), same position; qa-lints: Nidoran♀/♂ per zh 尼多兰/尼多朗 (glossary, RB-D01)

strings.zh: 小刚『嗯……几天没怎么进食,{NEWLINE}肚子却还是胀胀的,{CLEAR}看来是吃了不干净的东西。{CLEAR}细菌在体内分解食物残渣{CLEAR}造成胃部胀气……
strings.en: Brock: Hmm... It’s barely eaten in{NEWLINE}days, yet its belly is still bloated.{SCROLL}It must have eaten something bad.{NEWLINE}Bacteria breaking down the leftover{CLEAR}food are causing gas in its stomach...
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s), same position

strings.zh: 小刚『你好,训练家,{NEWLINE}请不要着急,{CLEAR}等我把尼多朗的问题解决{CLEAR}就回道馆接受你的挑战。
strings.en: Brock: Hello, Trainer. Don’t worry. As{NEWLINE}soon as I’ve taken care of Nidoran♂,{CLEAR}I’ll head back to the Gym to accept{CLEAR}your challenge.
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s), same position; qa-lints: Nidoran♀/♂ per zh 尼多兰/尼多朗 (glossary, RB-D01)

strings.zh: 小刚『你的尼多朗可能是{NEWLINE}吃了不干净的东西,{CLEAR}所以体内有一些积气,{CLEAR}我已经喂尼多朗吃了{CLEAR}顺气杀菌的草药丸,{CLEAR}过一段时间就会好了。
strings.en: Brock: Your Nidoran♂ probably ate{NEWLINE}something bad, so it has some gas built{CLEAR}up inside.{SCROLL}I’ve given it an herbal pill that settles{NEWLINE}the stomach and kills germs. It’ll be{CLEAR}fine after a while.
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s), same position; qa-lints: Nidoran♀/♂ per zh 尼多兰/尼多朗 (glossary, RB-D01)

strings.zh: 小刚『来,尼多朗,不要害怕,{NEWLINE}让我摸一摸你的肚子。
strings.en: Brock: Come on, Nidoran♂, don’t be{NEWLINE}scared. Let me feel your tummy.
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s), same position; qa-lints: Nidoran♀/♂ per zh 尼多兰/尼多朗 (glossary, RB-D01)

strings.zh: 尼多朗『Ga……
strings.en: Nidoran♂: Ga...
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s), same position; qa-lints: Nidoran♀/♂ per zh 尼多兰/尼多朗 (glossary, RB-D01)

strings.zh: 真的是多亏了你啊小刚先生,{NEWLINE}如果没有你,{CLEAR}我都不知道怎么办才好了。
strings.en: Thank you so much, Mr. Brock. I don’t{NEWLINE}know what I’d have done without you.
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s), same position

strings.zh: 小刚『好了,这里的事情解决了。{NEWLINE}我先回道馆准备一下,{CLEAR}随时欢迎前来挑战。
strings.en: Brock: All right, that takes{NEWLINE}care of things here. I’ll head{CLEAR}back to the Gym and get ready.{CLEAR}Come challenge me anytime.
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s), same position; layout rebalance 2026-10-09 (prompt icons / single-word page)

strings.zh: 小刚『尼多朗张张嘴,{NEWLINE}我这里有好吃的哟。
strings.en: Brock: Open wide, Nidoran♂. I’ve got{NEWLINE}something tasty for you.
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s), same position; qa-lints: Nidoran♀/♂ per zh 尼多兰/尼多朗 (glossary, RB-D01)

strings.zh: 小刚『嗯,真是个乖孩子呢。
strings.en: Brock: Mm-hm, what a good little guy.
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s), same position

strings.zh: 小刚『不必客气,{NEWLINE}我作为一名饲育家,{CLEAR}绝不能对精灵的痛苦坐视不理。
strings.en: Brock: Don’t mention it. As a Breeder, I{NEWLINE}can never turn a blind eye to a Pokémon{CLEAR}in pain.
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s), same position, flags page_breaks_lost

strings.zh: 谢谢你帮我留住了尼多兰！{NEWLINE}言语已经无法表达我的谢意。{SCROLL}如果你需要把旅行中{NEWLINE}收集到的柑果做成球的话,{CLEAR}我可以免费为您效劳！
strings.en: Thank you for helping me keep Nidoran♀!{NEWLINE}I can’t put my gratitude into words.{SCROLL}If you want the Apricorns you collect{NEWLINE}on your travels made into balls, I’ll do{CLEAR}it for free!
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s), same position; qa-lints: Nidoran♀/♂ per zh 尼多兰/尼多朗 (glossary, RB-D01)

strings.zh: 哦？拿柑果来了啊,{CLEAR}好咧,来做球吧！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Oh? You brought Apricorns? All right,{NEWLINE}let’s make a ball!{SCROLL}
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s), same position, flags page_breaks_lost

strings.zh: 制作一次球{NEWLINE}大约需要一天的时间。{CLEAR}到时候再来拿吧。
strings.en: Making a ball takes about a day. Come{NEWLINE}back for it then.
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s), same position, flags page_breaks_lost

strings.zh: 你身上没有柑果啊……{NEWLINE}感觉有些遗憾呐。
strings.en: You don’t have any Apricorns on you...{NEWLINE}That’s a bit of a letdown.
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s), same position

strings.zh: 我的技术还不够成熟,{NEWLINE}做球需要时间,{CLEAR}请耐心等一会儿。
strings.en: My skills aren’t polished yet, so making{NEWLINE}balls takes time. Please be patient.
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s), same position

strings.zh: 你的球已经做好了,{CLEAR}拿走吧！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Your ball is ready. Here you go!{SCROLL}
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s), same position, flags page_breaks_lost

strings.zh: 完成得太棒了！{SCROLL}接着去和精灵比试一下,{NEWLINE}看看能不能抓到它！
strings.en: It turned out great!{SCROLL}Now go test it against some Pokémon and{NEWLINE}see if you can catch one!
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s), same position

strings.zh: 听我儿子说,{NEWLINE}精灵被收纳在纯天然的柑果球里,{CLEAR}身心会更加舒适。{SCROLL}为了让尼多兰享受到{NEWLINE}更舒适的被收纳环境,{CLEAR}他才去城都学做柑果球的。
strings.en: My son says Pokémon feel more{NEWLINE}comfortable, body and mind, inside an{CLEAR}all-natural Apricorn Ball.{SCROLL}He went all the way to Johto to learn{NEWLINE}how to make them, just so Nidoran♀{CLEAR}could have a comfier ball.
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s), same position; qa-lints: Nidoran♀/♂ per zh 尼多兰/尼多朗 (glossary, RB-D01)

strings.zh: 调查外边的柑果树{NEWLINE}能收集到果实哦。{CLEAR}把果实给我,我就可以做球了。
strings.en: If you check the Apricorn tree outside,{NEWLINE}you can collect its fruit. Bring them to{CLEAR}me, and I can make balls.
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s), same position

strings.zh: 尼多兰『Ni——do——{NEWLINE}ran——！{SCROLL}叫声中充满了喜悦。
strings.en: Nidoran♀: Ni-do-ran-!{SCROLL}Its cry is full of joy.
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s), same position, flags page_breaks_lost; qa-lints: Nidoran♀/♂ per zh 尼多兰/尼多朗 (glossary, RB-D01)

strings.zh: 我儿子从城都地区{NEWLINE}学做柑果球回来后,{CLEAR}就兴冲冲地跑到2号路{CLEAR}找那只他一只挂念的尼多兰去了。
strings.en: When my son came back from Johto after{NEWLINE}learning to make Apricorn Balls...{SCROLL}...he rushed off to Route 2 to find the{NEWLINE}Nidoran♀ he’d been worrying about all{CLEAR}this time.
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s), same position; qa-lints: Nidoran♀/♂ per zh 尼多兰/尼多朗 (glossary, RB-D01)

strings.zh: 我儿子最近抓了一只尼多兰,{NEWLINE}好像很痴迷呢。
strings.en: My son caught a Nidoran♀ recently. He{NEWLINE}seems completely smitten with it.
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s), same position; qa-lints: Nidoran♀/♂ per zh 尼多兰/尼多朗 (glossary, RB-D01)

strings.zh: 我儿子最近好像非常抑郁,{NEWLINE}每天都念叨着尼多兰发呆,唉……
strings.en: My son seems really down lately. He{NEWLINE}mumbles about Nidoran♀ every day and{CLEAR}stares into space. Sigh...
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s), same position; qa-lints: Nidoran♀/♂ per zh 尼多兰/尼多朗 (glossary, RB-D01)

strings.zh: 我从城都地区的岩铁先生那里{NEWLINE}学会了制作柑果球,{CLEAR}现在需要大量的练习{CLEAR}来提升自身的技艺。{CLEAR}如果你能给我找来柑果的话,{CLEAR}我可以无偿地给你做球哦。
strings.en: I learned to make Apricorn Balls from{NEWLINE}Mr. Kurt in Johto. Now I need lots of{CLEAR}practice to hone my skills.{SCROLL}If you bring me Apricorns, I’ll make{NEWLINE}balls for you free of charge.
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s), same position

strings.zh: 我常跟自己说,{NEWLINE}只要尼多兰幸福就好,{CLEAR}可是它真的幸福吗？唉……
strings.en: I keep telling myself that as long as{NEWLINE}Nidoran♀ is happy, that’s all that{CLEAR}matters. But is it really happy? Sigh...
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s), same position; qa-lints: Nidoran♀/♂ per zh 尼多兰/尼多朗 (glossary, RB-D01)

strings.zh: 前段时间我太执着于做球了,{NEWLINE}反而忽略了对尼多兰的陪伴。{CLEAR}今后我决定把做球的事先放一边,{CLEAR}多花点时间陪陪尼多兰。
strings.en: For a while, I was so caught up in making{NEWLINE}balls that I neglected spending time{CLEAR}with Nidoran♀.{SCROLL}From now on, I’m putting ball-making{NEWLINE}aside to spend more time with Nidoran♀.
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s), same position; qa-lints: Nidoran♀/♂ per zh 尼多兰/尼多朗 (glossary, RB-D01)
